# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [다음 달 근무표, 아직 엑셀 붙잡고 며칠씩 짜고 계신가요? 근무표·교대 스케줄 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/shift-schedule-automation/): A practical guide to automating employee shift schedules: moving the manager's unwritten rules into a rules table split into hard constraints such as minimum staffing per time slot, required roles and consecutive-shift limits and soft preferences such as fair weekend distribution, collecting availability, leave and swap requests through one form with a deadline, generating a draft schedule with rule-based or optimization methods while highlighting understaffed slots and conflicts for the manager to resolve and confirm, routing shift swaps and absences to eligible coworkers with approval and change history, entering working-hour rules confirmed with labor specialists, and using AI only to structure messenger requests and summarize changes.
- ["최종_진짜최종.pdf", 어느 게 진짜인가요? 공유 폴더 문서 자동 분류·파일명 정리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/shared-folder-document-organization/): A practical guide to automatically organizing shared folder documents: defining file naming and folder rules for the most frequently searched document types, collecting incoming files from email, scanners and download folders, using OCR and AI only to identify the document type and extract counterparty, date and document number, matching names against the vendor master, applying fixed rules to decide file names and locations, handling duplicates and versions with hashes and logs instead of "final" in file names, and routing low-confidence documents to a human review queue.
- [신사업 시장 규모, 아직 감으로 적고 계신가요? 공공 통계로 시장 규모 추정하기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/market-sizing-public-statistics/): A practical guide to estimating market size from public statistics: defining TAM, SAM and SOM in terms of industry classification codes, regions and customer size bands, collecting business establishment, population and household spending statistics from sources such as KOSIS Open API with reference years recorded, calculating both top-down and bottom-up estimates from a separate assumptions table with fixed formulas, presenting results as scenario ranges, and recalculating when statistics are updated, with AI used only to check missing assumptions and draft explanations.
- [거래하던 회사가 이미 폐업했다는 걸 언제 알게 되셨나요? 거래처 휴·폐업 상태 자동 점검 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/business-partner-status-check/): A practical guide to automatically checking the business registration status of vendors and customers: cleaning business registration numbers in the vendor master, periodically querying the public National Tax Service status lookup for active, suspended or closed status and taxation type, comparing results with the previous check to alert only on changes along with open orders and receivables, checking status again right before registration, ordering and invoicing, and using AI only to summarize affected transactions while people decide how to handle them.
- [퇴사한 직원 계정, 지금도 살아 있지 않나요? 입사·퇴사 계정과 업무 인수인계 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/employee-onboarding-offboarding-automation/): A practical guide to automating employee onboarding and offboarding: using one confirmed HR record as the trigger, creating and revoking work tool accounts from role-based access templates, tracking equipment issue and return, generating handover checklists for customers, documents and recurring tasks, sending reminders to each owner, and periodically comparing active accounts against current staff, with AI used only to draft handover summaries and answer new-hire questions from approved documents.
- [상담 통화 내용, 아직 손으로 CRM에 옮겨 적고 계신가요? 상담 통화 요약·기록 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/call-summary-crm-automation/): A practical guide to automating customer call records: collecting disclosed call recordings, converting speech to text, having AI draft structured summaries with inquiry type, requests, mentioned conditions, commitments and next contact date, having the agent review and correct the draft before saving it to the CRM, and turning commitments into follow-up tasks and reminders, with personal data handling and retention agreed in advance.
- [누가 이 숫자를 바꿨는지 아무도 모른다면? 데이터 변경 이력·감사 로그 관리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-change-history-audit-log/): A practical guide to recording who changed key business data such as prices, discount rates, supplier bank accounts and contacts, inventory adjustments, metric definitions and user permissions, when and why, with before and after values, separating human edits from automated jobs, alerting on unusual changes, keeping logs append-only, and using AI only to summarize and search the change history.
- ["그 구매 건 승인 났어요?" 아직 메신저로 물어보고 계신가요? 구매 요청·발주 승인 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/purchase-request-approval-automation/): A practical guide to automating purchase requests and approvals: collecting requests through one form with required fields, routing approvals by amount, item type and budget rules, checking budget balance and duplicate or split requests automatically, using AI only to summarize and classify requests, and sending delay reminders and status updates through to order placement and receipt.
- [우리 품목 수출이 어느 나라에서 늘고 있는지 알고 계신가요? 수출입 무역통계 자동 수집·분석 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/trade-statistics-export-market-data/): A practical guide to automatically collecting public import and export statistics by HS code and country, keeping product code mappings and code revisions consistent, computing year-over-year change, country shares and value-per-weight indicators with fixed formulas, and comparing market trends with your own export results, with AI used only to summarize calculated figures.
- ["그 규정 어디 있어요?" 같은 질문, 아직 사람이 매번 답하고 계신가요? 사내 규정·업무 매뉴얼 AI 질의응답 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/internal-manual-ai-qa/): A practical guide to building an internal Q&A assistant over company policies and work manuals: consolidating the latest documents with owners and revision dates, retrieving only passages the asking employee is permitted to see, having AI answer strictly from those passages with source citations, and routing questions without a documented answer or requiring judgment to the responsible team.
